title: Meta video to interaction · SAM 3.1 + SAM 3D + Muse
disclosure: Muse Spark discovers independently moving components, audits source evidence and proposes the descriptive interaction program, then classifies persistent connections and removable parts in one additional guarded request. SAM 3.1 produces video masks; SAM 3D Objects reconstructs each selected component through the configured GPU worker. A private CPU fit estimates shared camera-relative motion and attached parts are replayed through joint constraints. A separate verified descriptive object program is indexed for humans and agents. Unsupported connections remain unknown; no independent floating-child or alternate mesh fallback is used. Geometry, depth, joint parameters, metric scale, contact and physical simulation remain unverified. Sampled source frames and segmentation are sent to Meta; selected RGB/masks are transferred to the configured cluster. The existing $5 mechanism-task, earlier increment and shared $100 estimated API guards all apply; these are not the account balance.
